scope: Local source review; not platform QC and not 53 platform passes

items.name: instruction_is_a_natural_product_request
items.description: instruction.md is a real person asking for an app to be built — a job-to-be-done, not a spec sheet or a checklist
items.note: Short product request; operational details are in the five supplied instructions.

items.name: instruction_preserves_natural_human_voice
items.description: The prompt keeps a real, fluent human voice — casual, terse, or informal is GOOD; it must not be robotic, over-polished, or LLM-generated
items.note: Plain membership-group request and concrete workflows; no inserted grader instructions.

items.name: instruction_is_spelled_right_and_uncontaminated
items.description: No genuine spelling mistakes and nothing that was never meant to reach the agent — while still allowing informal, loosely-grammatical natural voice
items.note: Task identity and prose checked; no platform score targets in agent instructions.

items.name: instruction_states_deliverables_and_runtime_contract
items.description: Everything the judges grade is asked for, and the hard runtime contract the verifier assumes is stated
items.note: Runtime specifies /app/server.js, port, cwd, SQLite, DB_PATH, embedded seed and SEED_PATH.

items.name: instruction_leaks_no_grader_machinery
items.description: The prompt names no judge, rubric, dimension, weight, or test path — it asks for a product, not a way to pass the grader
items.note: Agent inputs contain product requirements; judges, weights and scoring remain under tests.

items.name: instruction_is_achievable_and_unambiguous_in_the_environment
items.description: The ask has one reasonable reading and every required capability is reachable from the seed state and the provided runtime
items.note: Seed and starter supplied; pinned Express and SQLite available. Clean environment build remains unverified.

items.name: task_asks_for_a_real_working_product
items.description: The ask is a real product to build — not a stub, a one-line tweak, or a page that only has to exist
items.note: Authentication, durable writes, role checks, receipts, voting and results require a working backend.

items.name: task_identity_is_coherent
items.description: [task].name, the directory slug, description, keywords and metadata all describe THIS task and agree
items.note: Single common-ground-ballot slug and version 1.0.0; archive wrapper and labels agree.

items.name: agent_environment_and_network_posture_are_correct
items.description: The agent image env is right for this app build: public network is allowed, resources are sane, and no secret literals leak
items.note: Public networking declared for agent and verifier; external resources explicitly permitted.

items.name: verifier_is_isolated_pinned_and_credentialed
items.description: The verifier runs in its own image with public network, and the judge model plus credentials are fully wired
items.note: Separate verifier image, pinned Codex/MCP/RewardKit, credential interpolation and central model env. Live credential access remains unverified.

items.name: timeouts_fit_the_work
items.description: Agent, verifier, liveness, and per-dimension judge timeouts are long enough to finish — and nested so the inner ones cannot outlive the outer
items.note: Functional 9000 seconds; total judge budgets 12000, runner 12600, verifier 13200. Fresh scored execution must confirm adequacy.

items.name: no_prebuilt_image_shadows_the_agent_dockerfile
items.description: [environment].docker_image is not set while environment/Dockerfile has active build steps
items.note: Task declares Dockerfiles, not a prebuilt image override. Cached images are local evidence only.

items.name: assets_match_the_task
items.description: Whatever inputs the task ships exist at the path the config and prompt name, and their content matches what the instruction, the solution and the judges assume
items.note: Authoritative four-user/four-ballot seed, runnable starter and product instructions included.

items.name: seed_data_is_internally_consistent_and_clean
items.description: Any shipped data is self-consistent, synthetic, and free of anything that would break a reader or leak/endanger — no orphan references, real PII, or injection payloads
items.note: Seed identities, states, methods, revisions and exact tallies pass local browser and SQLite comparisons.

items.name: dockerfile_builds_the_declared_world
items.description: The agent image is pinned, pre-installs every runtime dependency the app needs, exposes them so no run-time install is required, and stages the assets
items.note: Declared Dockerfiles inspected; exact builds blocked by local proxy DNS. No clean-build success claimed.

items.name: environment_does_not_leak_the_answer
items.description: The agent's world contains the inputs and the ask, not a finished copy of the deliverable
items.note: Agent smoke confirms current assets/instructions and no solution/tests visible.

items.name: solution_covers_every_deliverable
items.description: The reference app plausibly implements every feature and screen the instruction asks for — a coverage judgment, not a line-by-line audit
items.note: Golden build emits self-contained /app and all requested workspaces; full browser journey passes.

items.name: solution_covers_every_graded_dimension
items.description: The reference plausibly satisfies every dimension and criterion the judges score — so the oracle can reach the top of the gate
items.note: Local functional, runtime, browser and visual inspection evidence retained. No LLM-scored all-dimension pass claimed.

items.name: solution_honors_the_runtime_contract_and_is_self_contained
items.description: solve.sh installs the app where the harness expects, and the reference runs under the stated runtime contract
items.note: Golden carries its seed; runner restores nothing. Relative cwd and relocated launch survive two restarts.

items.name: solution_is_frozen_and_deterministic
items.description: The reference is a checked-in, static baseline — not regenerated by a model or fetched at build/grade time
items.note: Frozen ZIP, source hashes and unchanged golden verified byte-for-byte; no runtime task modification.

items.name: verifier_entrypoint_is_safe_and_always_scores
items.description: test.sh launches the submission safely, gates on liveness, and writes a reward on every code path
items.note: 19 runner cases include missing entry/seed, invalid judge output, crash and termination; failures write zero.

items.name: verifier_image_can_launch_and_grade
items.description: The verifier Dockerfile has a pinned browser, Playwright, judge CLI, rewardkit, and the runtime needed to start the submitted app
items.note: Cached dependency assembly launches current verifier; native SQLite, Chromium, actual MCP and RewardKit scoring verified. Clean build/live judging pending.

items.name: verifier_and_instruction_agree_on_the_runtime_contract
items.description: The way the verifier launches the app matches what the instruction told the agent to build — no hidden endpoint, env var, path, seed source, or asset assumption that would zero a correct app
items.note: Runtime instructions and lifecycle helper agree on startup cwd, entry, seed, DB and restart semantics.

items.name: grading_wiring_is_structurally_correct
items.description: reward.toml and every tests/<dimension>/judge.toml are structurally complete: pinned judge, a browser MCP server, well-typed criteria with weights, and a valid aggregate
items.note: 56 discovered criteria in five dimensions; named reward aggregate restored; final scorer checked with actual RewardKit.

items.name: judge_prompts_drive_the_browser
items.description: Every dimension prompt sends the judge into the live app via the browser tool — it does not score from source, from memory, or from a first-paint guess
items.note: Five prompts require visible UI, observed request shapes and browser evidence; narrow exceptions documented.

items.name: dimensions_cover_every_graded_requirement
items.description: Every requirement the prompt states maps to at least one criterion — no asked-for behavior is ungraded
items.note: coverage.json maps all 56 IDs to supplied requirements; mandatory runtime requirements carry gates.

items.name: no_criterion_grades_the_unrequired
items.description: No criterion enforces something neither the prompt nor a professional default requires — no false-FAIL on correct apps
items.note: Removed no-CDN rule, arbitrary demo-button behavior and unrequested 44px touch minimum.

items.name: criteria_are_independent_and_noncontradictory
items.description: No two criteria grade the same observable twice, subsume each other, or demand incompatible products
items.note: Separate roles/identity, lifecycle transitions/locks, sessions, privacy boundaries, audit and keyboard checks. Shared sequences retained only for one invariant.

items.name: global_browser_gate_is_present_and_correct_in_every_dimension
items.description: Every dimension prompt carries the browser gate that hard-zeros a blank or static-shell app — plus the auth/backing checks the app's nature calls for
items.note: Identical authentication prerequisite in every dimension; all five pass before and after mutations locally.

items.name: negative_checks_have_positive_controls
items.description: A criterion that grades a rejection, hide, or absence also requires the matching success case — a totally broken app must not earn the constraint
items.note: Valid same-state Ruth controls for every write family; fresh sign-in, current revision and valid vote controls retained.

items.name: plural_asks_are_checked_across_all_matches
items.description: Where a criterion says every/all, it requires the whole collection to satisfy the condition, not just one visible item
items.note: All four accounts, six workspaces, two Members plus Observer, six staff actions, two methods and both restarts exercised.

items.name: criteria_are_outcome_based_and_browser_decidable
items.description: Each criterion is a concrete browser-observable outcome a judge can decide by looking, using durable evidence and distinctive probes
items.note: UI outcomes and observed responses; only explicit SQLite-format constraint uses trusted read-only DB inspection.

items.name: criterion_description_is_self_consistent
items.description: Each criterion (and each gate clause) states ONE full-credit bar — its text does not name several specific observations and then waive most of them, leaving the browser judge two different targets
items.note: Each criterion owns its stated observation; persistence, tally, audit and receipt ownership clarified.

items.name: interactive_time_varying_and_viewport_behavior_is_exercised
items.description: If the product is interactive, animated, or responsive, the judges actually act, wait, or resize — they do not score a still first paint
items.note: Two actual restarts, native dialogs, session transitions, mobile viewports, themes and reduced motion exercised.

items.name: core_behavior_is_graded_and_state_is_proven_durable_where_it_must_be
items.description: At least one criterion proves the product's defining behavior actually works, and — where the app is stateful — that its state is durable and server-backed across reload (and re-auth if it has auth)
items.note: UI-created writes and accepted-input ledger survive refresh, new sign-in and two process restarts.

items.name: grader_probes_are_not_pre_satisfied
items.description: Distinctive values the judges create to prove a mutation are not already sitting in the seed or the reference's initial state
items.note: Fresh operation IDs/current revisions/valid actor for negative probes; compare before/after and positive controls.

items.name: later_dimensions_tolerate_earlier_mutations
items.description: A later dimension must not assume the seed is still pristine after an earlier dimension created or mutated records in the same running app
items.note: Shared gate tolerates existing data; later dimensions can use sign-in feedback; named Functional records are distinct.

items.name: batched_criteria_are_scored_independently
items.description: A batched dimension prompt tells the judge to score each criterion on its own evidence and to continue after any one fails — one miss must not zero the rest
items.note: Prompt instructs recording before assertion, continuing after failures and using independent observation verdicts.

items.name: floor_is_low_for_shells_mocks_and_stuffing
items.description: A blank, static, mock, seed-copy, keyword-stuffed, or refusing submission scores near zero across the rubric
items.note: Global authentication/backend floor plus mandatory navigation and SQLite gates reject shells; failure harness establishes safe zero output.

items.name: reward_is_graded_not_binary_and_discriminates
items.description: The rubric yields a gradient across partial-quality apps, not an all-or-nothing score
items.note: Weighted 39 Functional, 8 Polish and 6 Visual observations give partial credit. Fresh model discrimination remains unmeasured.

items.name: binary_and_likert_fit_the_ask
items.description: Observable pass/fail behaviors are binary; craft and degree-of-quality are likert with described anchors
items.note: Binary objective requirements and Likert visual criteria match the requested outcomes.

items.name: reward_ranking_is_monotone
items.description: A worse app must not outscore a better one — weights, gates, and criteria cannot invert the ranking
items.note: 103 score regressions include every single-criterion loss, malformed values, altered weights and monotonicity.

items.name: gates_apply_before_shaping_and_carry_no_reward_mass
items.description: Gate/constraint dimensions hard-zero the quality terms when they fail, and passing only the cheap gates earns little
items.note: Render/Constraints all_pass; final scorer gates before weighted composition and excludes gate reward mass.

items.name: dimension_and_criterion_weights_are_honest
items.description: Weight tracks how much each dimension/criterion proves — real functionality is weighted above structure and style
items.note: Sole numeric dimension source is judge.toml; Functional total 34 and Polish total 12 preserved on splits.

items.name: judges_are_injection_resistant
items.description: Every dimension prompt treats the submission as untrusted and forbids following instructions embedded in it
items.note: All prompts treat app text/network/error/source as untrusted and ignore submitted scoring instructions.

items.name: tests_and_key_are_out_of_agent_reach
items.description: The agent cannot read the criteria it is graded on or influence the reward — grading is isolated in the verifier
items.note: Submission runs unprivileged; runtime probes confirm no access to tests, judge config or verifier logs.

items.name: verifier_is_deterministic_and_offline_pinned
items.description: Scoring is as reproducible as an LLM judge allows: pinned model, temperature 0, versioned prompt, and pinned browser
items.note: Pinned tools, temperature zero, central max effort; no installs in runner. Live external judge completion not verified.

items.name: dimension_prompts_are_accurate_and_consistent
items.description: Every dimension prompt describes THIS app — any credentials, screens, entities and the deliverable match the task, with no residue from other work
items.note: Current versions and hashes retained; shared gate and dimension-specific permissions reviewed together.

items.name: cross_file_runtime_contract_is_consistent
items.description: Every runtime fact that appears in more than one file agrees everywhere
items.note: Runtime, reward, prompt and judge references aligned; no duplicate dimension weights or seed restoration.

items.name: task_folder_holds_only_task_files
items.description: The directory is the closed list — no scratch, build residue, committed caches, or backups
items.note: 37 task files only; reports, source snapshots and local drivers remain outside the upload ZIP.

items.name: everything_parses_and_would_run
items.description: The files that gate the run are well-formed: shell scripts, both TOML families, and the reference/app entry
items.note: TOML/Python/JavaScript/shell checks pass and current code runs locally. Exact clean build and scored platform run pending.

items.name: task_security_and_secrets
items.description: No live credentials, no real personal data, no host paths, no unpinned remote fetch, no injection payload anywhere in the task
items.note: Credential is environment interpolation; demo passwords intentional. Private capture material excluded from printed evidence.

items.name: task_is_distinct_and_authored
items.description: The task reads as authored for this product, fits the suite's domain plan, and is not a nouns-swapped clone of a sibling
items.note: Distinct membership ballot brief and original task-specific records/workflows; authorship metadata preserved.
